name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Super Lemon Haze
description: Get ready for a zesty explosion of energy with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Super Lemon Haze, a powerful, citrus-packed sativa known for its invigorating effects and bold flavor. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this terpene-rich live resin wax delivers a smooth, flavorful, and electrifying dab every time. With bright lemon, tangy citrus, and sweet herbal undertones, Super Lemon Haze provides an instant cerebral rush, enhancing mood, focus, and creativity while keeping you energized and uplifted. Perfect for daytime sessions, social activities, and powering through tasks, this strain keeps you fresh, focused, and full of life.
